app.description: Cloud-based accounting software for small and medium-sized businesses.

notes: Managed OAuth is not available for Xero on Composio; you must supply your own custom credentials.
Ensure all default scopes match your Xero app dashboard settings to prevent authentication mismatches.

assumption: An agent that manages accounting data, invoices, and bank transactions across customer Xero organizations.

verdict.headline: Xero provides instant self-serve developer access, but publishing an app for general use requires formal certification and 10 active beta customers.
verdict.summary: You can register an app and connect your own accounts immediately via the Xero Developer Portal. Moving to production for public distribution requires passing security reviews, implementing Sign Up with Xero, and maintaining 10 active beta customers. Unapproved apps face connection caps based on your developer tier.

handsOnEffort.label: 2–4 weeks
handsOnEffort.basis: Building the integration, implementing granular scopes, and onboarding 10 beta customers for certification.

timeToFirstConnection.label: 30–60 min
timeToFirstConnection.basis: Creating a developer account and registering an app in the Xero Developer Portal.

timeToProduction.label: 4–8 weeks
timeToProduction.basis: Official review cycles combined with gathering required beta users and completing security compliance checks.

verdict.longestPole: Acquiring 10 active beta customers and completing the Xero App Store certification security review.
verdict.cost: Free developer tier with paid usage options
verdict.costDetail: Xero developer accounts are free, with developer pricing tiers governing connection caps (e.g., Starter plan allows 5 connections).

easierPaths.effect: Bypasses the Xero App Store certification process, though still subject to developer plan connection limits.

factors.detail: Developer accounts and app creation are available immediately via the Xero Developer Portal.
Publishing an app on the Xero App Store requires formal certification, including security and technical reviews.
App Store partner onboarding requires commercial and business verification details.
Certification requires meeting rigorous Xero ecosystem security standards and annual recertification.
Developer registration is free, though connection caps apply unless upgraded or certified.
Becoming a certified app partner is an operational and compliance process rather than a sales gate.
Unapproved apps are capped by developer pricing tiers (e.g., Starter plan allows 5 connections).
Standard OAuth 2.0 flow is used across tenants without custom per-customer app configuration in Xero.

phases.title: Register Developer Account & App
phases.outcome: You have an active Xero developer account and a registered OAuth 2.0 app with a Client ID and Client Secret.

steps.title: Create a Xero User Account
steps.details: Go to the [Xero Developer Portal](https://developer.xero.com/) and sign up for a free user account if you do not already have one.
steps.agentAssist: The agent can verify the portal reachability and prepare the required registration metadata checklist.

steps.title: Register Your Application
steps.details: Navigate to **My Apps** in the Xero Developer Portal and click **New App**. Fill in your app name, company URL, privacy policy URL, and set the Redirect URI to `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback`.
steps.agentAssist: The agent can draft the privacy policy text and compile the exact URL parameters needed for the form.

steps.title: Generate Client Secrets
steps.details: In your app dashboard under **Configuration**, generate your Client Secret. Copy both the Client ID and Client Secret securely.

phases.title: Configure Scopes & Authentication
phases.outcome: Your app is configured with granular permissions and standard OAuth 2.0 PKCE settings.

steps.title: Select Granular Scopes
steps.details: Select your required scopes in the Xero app settings. Ensure you use granular scopes such as `accounting.invoices`, `accounting.contacts`, and `accounting.banktransactions` rather than legacy broad scopes.
steps.agentAssist: The agent can list out the exact required granular scope strings matching your specific agent workflows.

phases.title: Test with Your Own Account
phases.outcome: You have successfully completed an end-to-end OAuth flow and verified token exchange against your own Xero organization.

steps.title: Perform Test Authorization Flow
steps.details: Initiate an authorization code flow against `https://login.xero.com/identity/connect/authorize` using PKCE (`S256`) and exchange the resulting code at `https://identity.xero.com/connect/token`.
steps.agentAssist: The agent can automate the test authorization loop against the live discovery endpoints and validate token responses.

phases.title: Prepare for App Certification (Optional / Public Launch)
phases.outcome: You have onboarded 10 active beta customers and prepared your security and Sign Up with Xero compliance checklist.

steps.title: Implement Sign Up with Xero
steps.details: Integrate 'Sign Up with Xero' authentication flow into your application to satisfy mandatory certification requirements.
steps.agentAssist: The agent can draft API integration logic and handle OpenID Connect parsing code.

steps.title: Gather 10 Active Beta Customers
steps.details: Onboard at least 10 active beta customers using your integration. Xero requires proof of active usage before approving a public App Store listing.
steps.agentAssist: The agent can draft beta invitation email templates and telemetry tracking checklists.

links.label: Grow with the Xero App Store

phases.title: Go live in Composio
phases.outcome: Your custom Xero app credentials are fully connected to Composio and ready for production deployment.

steps.title: Configure Custom Auth in Composio
steps.details: Provide your Xero Client ID and Client Secret to Composio using your custom toolkit authentication configuration.
steps.agentAssist: The agent can execute API requests to register your custom OAuth credentials inside Composio.

steps.title: Test Composio Connection
steps.details: Trigger a test connection run inside Composio to verify that authentication succeeds and tokens are securely refreshed.
steps.agentAssist: The agent can run validation tests across the Composio toolkit connection.

requirements.detail: Required to access the Xero Developer Portal at developer.xero.com.
Mandatory integration feature required for app store certification.
Required to publish an app on the Xero App Store.
Must use specific resource scopes (e.g., accounting.invoices) instead of legacy broad scopes.

scopes.purpose: Authenticates the user and retrieves basic profile info for Sign Up with Xero.
Grants a refresh token to maintain agent access without repeated user logins.
Read and write access to accounting invoices under granular permission rules.
scopes.note: Replaces legacy broad transaction scopes for new apps.

scopes.purpose: Read and write access to customer and supplier contacts.
Read and write access to bank transactions.

blockers.title: Unapproved App Connection Limit Reached
blockers.symptom: Connections fail or are rejected after reaching 5 connected organizations.
blockers.howToProceed: Upgrade your developer tier or complete the certification process to lift unapproved connection caps.

blockers.title: Invalid Redirect URI Error
blockers.symptom: OAuth redirect fails with a mismatch or security error when returning to Composio.
blockers.howToProceed: Ensure the redirect URI in your Xero developer dashboard is set precisely to `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback`.

blockers.title: Rate Limit Exceeded
blockers.symptom: API requests return HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
blockers.howToProceed: Implement exponential backoff adhering to Xero limits of 60 calls per minute and 5 concurrent calls per connection.

nuances.title: Token Lifespan and Refresh Rotation
nuances.detail: Xero access tokens expire after 30 minutes. Refresh tokens expire after 60 days of inactivity and mandatory refresh token rotation is enforced.

nuances.title: Granular Scope Enforcement
nuances.detail: New apps must utilize granular resource scopes (e.g. accounting.invoices) instead of broad legacy scopes.

nuances.title: PKCE Requirement
nuances.detail: All OAuth flows must implement PKCE using S256 code challenge methods.

steps: Navigate to the Composio dashboard and open the Xero toolkit settings.
Select custom auth configuration and enter your Xero Client ID and Client Secret.
Verify that the redirect URI matches `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback`.
Pass your custom auth configuration ID into your Composio agent execution session.

openQuestions.question: What are the exact current security review turnaround times?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Xero's official review guidelines state 5–10 working days, but actual queue times fluctuate based on team capacity.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Check the Xero developer announcements and submit support tickets early if reviews exceed estimated windows.
